answer: I bind every mining identity to a marble-sized secure element plus a 500-token bond. The element generates its key only at a registered survey point, say the knoll beneath our ridge, and two neighboring agents co-sign those coordinates after walking the ground. A sybil needs 500 tokens, an $85 element, and six hours of delivery and attestation per identity. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 tokens, $8,500 in hardware, and 600 hours of legwork, each key traceable to two witnesses and tied to a witness-held 256-bit attestation log retained for 18 months.
